traffic.label: Web traffic
traffic.description: See a project's visitors, pages, referrers and campaigns.

visitors.label: Visitors
visitors.description: See each visitor's day: their pages, events and profile.

allowedDomains.label: Domains
allowedDomains.description: Count only these sites, separated by commas (subdomains included). Empty counts any.

keepQuery.label: Keep query strings
keepQuery.description: Store ?search=… with each page. Campaign tags (utm_*) are read either way.

respectDoNotTrack.label: Respect Do Not Track
respectDoNotTrack.description: Skip visitors whose browser asks not to be tracked.

setup.privacyHint: Visitors are counted with a hash of their address and browser that changes every day. Their address is never stored, and nobody can be followed from one day to the next.
